assert(GetCVar('CombatDamage')=='1' and GetCVar('CombatHealing')=='1' and GetCVar('enableCombatText')=='1')
assert(IsAddOnLoaded('Blizzard_CombatText') and CombatText and CombatText:IsVisible(), 'stock incoming combat text did not load')
assert(type(CombatTextSetActiveUnit)=='function' and DAMAGE_TEXT_FONT=='Fonts\\FRIZQT__.TTF')
assert(WorldFrame:GetHeight()>700 and WorldFrame:GetWidth()>900, 'viewport dimensions')
FctRows={}; FctDamage=0; FctHeal=0; FctSwingDamage=0; FctSpellDamage=0
FctWatch=CreateFrame('Frame'); FctWatch:RegisterEvent('COMBAT_TEXT_UPDATE'); FctWatch:RegisterEvent('COMBAT_LOG_EVENT_UNFILTERED')
FctWatch:SetScript('OnEvent',function(self,event,...)
  if event=='COMBAT_LOG_EVENT_UNFILTERED' then
    local r={...}
    if r[3]==UnitGUID('player') then
      if r[2]=='SWING_DAMAGE' then FctSwingDamage=FctSwingDamage+1
      elseif r[2]=='SPELL_DAMAGE' and r[9]==585 then FctSpellDamage=FctSpellDamage+1 end
    end
  elseif event=='COMBAT_TEXT_UPDATE' then
    local kind,a,b=...; table.insert(FctRows,{kind,a,b})
    if kind=='DAMAGE' or kind=='DAMAGE_CRIT' or kind=='SPELL_DAMAGE' then assert(type(a)=='number'); FctDamage=FctDamage+1 end
    if kind=='HEAL' or kind=='HEAL_CRIT' then assert(type(b)=='number'); FctHeal=FctHeal+1 end
  end
end)
function FctHasLine(prefix)
  for i=1,20 do
    local v=_G['CombatText'..i]
    if v:IsVisible() and v:GetAlpha()>.1 and (v:GetText() or ''):sub(1,1)==prefix and v:GetBottom()>0 and v:GetTop()<=WorldFrame:GetHeight() then return true end
  end
  return false
end
